description: Get flow analytics. The builder's Analytics panel for one flow: runs, completions, completion rate and median time for the window, the same numbers for the preceding window (comparison), lifetime totals, outcomes (emails and phones collected, leads marked, bookings, link clicks, handoffs), per-node reach, continue, response and loss rates, and per-port branch splits. Analytics are per published version: version defaults to the current one; versions lists the others. Only sessions with tracking are counted; other_version_runs_excluded says how many ran under another version in the window.

range.description: Window: 7d, 30d, 90d or all. Default 30d. Comparison is null for all.

version.description: A published version number from versions[]. Default: the current version.

name: get_flow_analytics
